The compiled React frontend serving mechanism and exact file path have been identified.

Vite compiles the React frontend to `server/router/frontend/dist` via `pnpm release`. The `embed` package bundles these static files into the Go binary. The Echo web framework serves them through `middleware.StaticWithConfig` and provides SPA fallback by serving `index.html` for client-side routing. The wiring is in `/bench/repo/server/server.go` at lines 71-72, where `frontend.NewFrontendService(profile, store).Serve(ctx, echoServer)` is invoked.

The implementation resides in `/bench/repo/server/router/frontend/frontend.go`.
